data.one_liner: GitHub-like activity calendar widget to display activity over a period of time.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable calendar widget resembling GitHub's contribution graph. Supports both vertical and horizontal layouts, optional tooltips, and tap listeners for each day.
use_when: You want to display a contribution or activity grid similar to GitHub
You need a calendar widget that shows activity counts per day with optional tooltips
avoid_when: You need a full-featured event calendar with scheduling and reminders
You require complex chart types other than activity grids
strengths: Supports customizable views and vertical or horizontal layouts
Includes optional tooltip builders for text and rich text
Easy to use by passing a list of integers representing activity counts
weaknesses: Not documented for non-standard calendar types
